title: ObservationVLA Payload
description: The eight-key JSON contract every ObservationVLA backend (clip_local, gemma4, genesis, tesseract_t3, ...) must emit. Defined as a Python tuple in transformers_vlm_local.py REQUIRED_KEYS; this schema is the machine-readable parity check.

usable_observation.description: Is the observation usable for downstream mission action? Approximately equivalent to operator 'useful' label.

scene_match_score.description: How well the imagery matches the planner's expectation of the target scene type. 1.0 = exact match, 0.0 = unrecognizable.

salience_score.description: Operational salience of what is visible — how decision-relevant the observation is. 1.0 = highly informative, 0.0 = uninformative.

change_or_event_score.description: Likelihood the scene contains a notable change or event vs the reference baseline. 1.0 = clear anomaly, 0.0 = nominal.

occlusion_or_cloud_risk.description: Risk that occlusion (cloud, shadow, glint) is degrading the observation. 1.0 = severely occluded, 0.0 = clear sky.

confidence.description: Backend's self-confidence in the assessment. Used by the trust layer for accept/refine/defer/skip gating.

recommended_action.description: Suggested mission action. accept=commit, refine=secondary pass needed, defer=wait for next overpass, skip=not worth bandwidth. Operator review may override.

rationale_tags.description: Free-form short tags explaining the recommendation. Examples: cloud_risk, high_priority, edge_geometry, low_cloud_risk, line_of_sight, sentinel_available, compound_risk_refine.
